map.基于WHO麻风病残疾分级系统，评估麻风患者周围神经损害与残疾程度，指导康复治疗: Based on the WHO leprosy disability grading system, assess peripheral nerve damage and disability in leprosy patients to guide rehabilitation.
map.手和足（取最高级别）: Hands and feet (take the highest grade)
map.0级 - 无感觉丧失，无可见畸形: Grade 0 - no sensory loss, no visible deformity
map.手/足感觉正常，无肌肉萎缩或运动障碍: Normal hand/foot sensation, no muscle atrophy or motor impairment
map.1级 - 有感觉丧失，但无可见畸形: Grade 1 - sensory loss but no visible deformity
map.保护性感觉丧失（不能感受针尖/棉絮），但外观正常: Protective sensation loss (cannot feel pinprick / cotton), but appearance normal
map.2级 - 有感觉丧失且有可见畸形: Grade 2 - sensory loss with visible deformity
map.爪形手/垂足/足底溃疡/肌肉萎缩/复杂性畸形/截肢: Claw hand / foot drop / plantar ulcer / muscle atrophy / complex deformity / amputation
map.视力正常，无角膜感觉丧失，无眼睑畸形: Normal vision, no corneal sensation loss, no eyelid deformity
map.1级 - 有角膜感觉丧失或轻度眼病: Grade 1 - corneal sensation loss or mild eye disease
map.角膜感觉丧失，但无视力损害或眼睑畸形: Corneal sensation loss but no visual impairment or eyelid deformity
map.2级 - 严重视力损害或失明: Grade 2 - severe visual impairment or blindness
map.视力<6/60、兔眼（眼睑闭合不全）、虹膜睫状体炎、角膜溃疡: Vision <6/60, lagophthalmos (incomplete eyelid closure), iridocyclitis, corneal ulcer
map.无感觉丧失，无可见畸形: No sensory loss, no visible deformity
map.角膜感觉丧失，无视力损害: Corneal sensation loss, no visual impairment
map.感觉丧失+可见畸形（爪手/溃疡/截肢）: Sensory loss + visible deformity (claw hand / ulcer / amputation)
map.1. 多菌型(MB: BB/BL/LL)：利福平+氨苯砜+氯法齐明，疗程12个月: 1. Multibacillary (MB: BB/BL/LL): rifampicin + dapsone + clofazimine, 12-month course. 2. Paucibacillary (PB: TT/BT): rifampicin + dapsone, 6-month course. After completing MDT, even if lesions remain, the patient is cured and no longer contagious.
map.麻风病可防可治不可怕。早期诊断和及时MDT治疗是防止残疾的关键。2级残疾（G2D: Leprosy is preventable, treatable, and not to be feared. Early diagnosis and timely MDT are key to preventing disability. Grade 2 disability (G2D) is an important indicator of leprosy control; WHO targets G2D in <1% of new cases. Refer if the following 'suspected leprosy signs' appear: 1. skin shows pale/red patches with sensory loss; 2. hands/feet numbness with muscle weakness; 3. face shows infiltrative nodules or plaques; 4. peripheral nerve enlargement with tenderness.
map.皮损计数：录入可见皮肤皮损（麻木性斑块）数量，工具按 ≤5 / >5 区分 PB: Lesion counting: enter the number of visible skin lesions (anesthetic plaques); the tool distinguishes PB from MB by ≤5 / >5.
map.神经评估：标注是否伴周围神经粗大、麻木或肌无力，提示需神经功能监测与足量联合化疗: Nerve assessment: mark whether accompanied by peripheral nerve enlargement, numbness, or weakness, suggesting nerve function monitoring and adequate multidrug therapy.
map.方案提示：依分型给出 WHO-MDT（少菌 6 个月 / 多菌 12 个月）的方: Regimen cue: by classification, give directional reference for WHO-MDT (paucibacillary 6 months / multibacillary 12 months), emphasizing standardized medication and follow-up.
map.示例：全身 3 块麻木性红斑、伴右侧尺神经粗大 → 评为 PB（少菌型），提示神: Example: 3 anesthetic erythematous patches over the body with right ulnar nerve enlargement → rated PB (paucibacillary), indicating nerve involvement needing MDT and regular nerve function checks.
map.PB 和 MB 哪个重？: Which is more severe, PB or MB?
map.MB（多菌型）菌量高、传染性相对强、疗程更长；分型以皮损数与涂片为准，具体由专科: MB (multibacillary) has higher bacillary load, relatively stronger contagiousness, and a longer course; typing rests on lesion count and smear, set by the specialist per standards.
